sources.title: Sofradir and ULIS merge under Lynred name — 4 June 2019

rounds.note_en: CORDIS names LYNRED as current beneficiary; project description identifies historical Sofradir participation. Issuer confirms Sofradir and ULIS merged as Lynred in June 2019. Amount is the beneficiary net EU grant allocation, not consortium total, project cost or cash paid on signature. Date is EC grant-agreement signature; project start is not substituted.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Two beneficiary-specific EU grants verified with predecessor continuity. Remaining EU/EDF project allocations and grant history remain under review.
